📲 Add Scratch Map to your Home Screen

  1. Tap the Share button ⬆︎ (bottom of the screen in Safari).
  2. Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
  3. Tap Add. Open Scratch Map from its new icon, and it runs full-screen like any other app, even offline.

Places you've marked in the browser don't carry over to the Home Screen app automatically. Save a backup file first (⋯ menu), then restore it in the app.
